landing_seo_description: Watch The Office with friends in synced watch parties: shared playback, live reactions, and comments on every episode. Free and ad-free.
landing_hero_title: Watch The Office with your friends.
landing_hero_description: Start a private room, invite your friends, and watch any episode together with live reactions and comments.
landing_hero_donation_note: Free to use and funded by donations.
landing_how_it_works_heading: Start a watch party in three steps
landing_how_it_works_description: Nothing to install. Everyone watches from their own device.
landing_step_create_room_description: Pick an episode and open a private room.
landing_step_invite_description: Add friends by email or send them a link.
landing_step_play_description: The room owner controls playback. React and comment while you watch.
landing_features_description: Everything you need to watch together, plus a few extras for fans.
landing_feature_sync_description: Create a private room, invite friends, and watch together.
landing_feature_reactions_description: React in real time and see your friends' reactions as they happen.
landing_feature_comments_description: Every episode has a comment thread. Read what other fans think or add your own.
landing_feature_favorites_description: Save favorite episodes and pick up right where you left off.
landing_feature_trivia_description: A new question about the show every day.
landing_feature_guide_description: Browse every season and episode, no account needed.
landing_support_description: OfficeWatchParty costs about {monthlyCost} a month to run, and donations cover it. If you enjoy it, you can chip in.
landing_account_description: Watch parties, comments, and favorites need a free account. You can sign in with a one-time code sent to your email, or with your Google account. We use your email address only to sign you in, let room owners add you to their parties, save your activity, and show your username (the part before the "@") on comments you post. We never sell your data or use it for advertising.
landing_final_cta_description: Sign in with your email or Google account and start your first room in under a minute.
